unit: 强调句与 it 句型专题
topic: 强调句与 it 的用法
summary: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分，可强调主语、宾语、状语；另掌握 it 作形式主语/宾语、指时间天气等用法。
signals: It is/was...that 去框架仍完整

rules.title: 强调句型：It is/was + 强调部分 + that/who + 其余
rules.detail: 强调人可用 who；强调物只用 that；去掉 It is/was...that 句子仍然完整成立——这是判断强调句的金标准。

examples.en: It was Tom that/who broke the window.
It was in this room that the meeting was held.
examples.zh: 会议就是在这个房间举行的。
examples.highlight: It was in this room that

rules.title: 强调句的疑问形式
rules.detail: 一般疑问：Was it Tom that broke the window?；特殊疑问：Who was it that...? / What was it that...?

examples.en: Who was it that called me last night?
examples.zh: 昨晚到底是谁给我打电话？

rules.title: it 的其他常见用法
rules.detail: ① 形式主语/宾语：It is no use crying. / We find it hard to understand him. ② 指时间、距离、天气：It is 5 km from here. ③ It is/was + 时间点 + since/when/before 句型辨析。

examples.en: We find it difficult to get along with him.
examples.zh: 我们发现很难与他相处。

examples.en: It is/has been three years since he left.

pitfalls: 强调句与定语从句混淆：It was the house where I lived.（定从，where）vs It was the house that I visited.（强调句，去框架仍完整）
强调时间/地点误用 when/where：强调句一律用 that（强调人还可用 who）
It is no use 后接 to do：应用 doing（It is no use crying.）

questions.stem: It was in the lab ___ the experiment was carried out.
questions.explain: 强调地点状语 in the lab，强调句框架用 that（即使强调的是地点也不用 where）。

questions.stem: ___ was it ___ made the school famous?
questions.explain: 强调主语 what（作 made 的主语）的特殊疑问强调句：What was it that...?

questions.stem: We all consider ___ our duty to protect the environment.
questions.explain: it 作形式宾语，真正的宾语是不定式 to protect...。

questions.stem: ___ two years ___ we last met in Beijing.
questions.explain: It is/has been + 时间段 + since + 过去时：自上次见面已两年。

questions.stem: ___ ___ no use arguing with him. (two words)
questions.explain: It is no use doing sth 固定句型：和某人争辩没用。

questions.stem: It was because of the heavy rain ___ the sports meeting was put off.
questions.explain: 强调原因状语 because of the heavy rain，框架用 that。

questions.stem: It was last night when I heard the strange noise.
questions.explain: 强调时间状语 last night 用 that；如果去掉框架句子完整（I heard the noise last night），就是强调句。

questions.stem: 就是在那个小村庄里度过了他的童年。（翻译整句，spend his childhood）
answer: it was in that small village that he spent his childhood.
it was in the small village that he spent his childhood.
questions.explain: 强调地点 in that small village，用 It was...that...框架。

questions.stem: 你到底是什么意思？（翻译整句，mean）
answer: what on earth do you mean?
what is it that you mean?
questions.explain: 可用强调句特殊疑问 What is it that you mean? 或加 on earth 加强语气。
